result.topic_en: The page concludes the discussion of the elastic curve, noting that the amplitude is bounded when m > 1, which yields the species of elastic curves treated in the Isoperimetric Problem treatise; it then justifies omitting further equilibrium examples and begins the second general problem on the motion of flexible or elastic threads.
